title: Integrated in-silico and in-vitro analysis of lncRNA H19/miRNA-675/p53 in OSCC: Structural characterization and molecular docking insights.
authors: Sekar, Ramya; Jayaraman, Selvaraj; Veeraraghavan, Vishnupriya; Varadarajan, Saranya; Alagumuthu, Manikandan; Rajendran, Peramaiyan; Venkatesalu, Bargavi
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过RNA二级结构预测和分子对接分析lncRNA H19/miRNA-675与p53的互作，但核心是RNA-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且缺乏TF-DNA结合机制与AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNA) H19 has drawn special attention because of its varied role in several malignancies, including OSCC. Therefore, this study was conducted to assess the association between H19-miR675-p53 by in-silico analysis, quantify the expression levels of H19, miRNA-675, and target oncogene p53 in cancerous versus normal individuals, and Correlate the Clinicopathological findings with their expression pattern. METHODS: The secondary structure of lncRNA H19 was predicted using the RNAfold web server ( http://rna.tbi.univie.ac.at/cgi-bin/RNAWebSuite/RNAfold.cgi ). The FASTA sequence of H19 was retrieved from the NCBI database ( https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ ). We performed molecular docking studies to analyze the interaction between miRNA-675 and p53 using the MDockPP ( https://zougrouptoolkit.missouri.edu/MDockPP/ ) web server. Real-time PCR was used to measure the amounts of H19 and miR-675, and Immunohistochemistry was used to analyse the pattern of p53 expression. RESULT: The study successfully associated miR-675 from the first exon of H19 modulating p53 via in silico analysis. It was found that H19 and miR-675 levels were higher in OSCC patients (3.12 +/- 1.16) compared to healthy patients (1.0 +/- 0.0), and was statistically significant (p-value < 0.001). CONCLUSION: The specificity of H19 expression in OSCC compared to normal presents an attractive target for cancer-specific therapies, minimizing the risk of off-target effects.
abstract_zh: 背景：长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）H19因其在包括口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）在内的多种恶性肿瘤中的多重作用而受到特别关注。因此，本研究旨在通过计算机模拟分析评估H19-miR675-p53之间的关联，定量检测癌症患者与正常个体中H19、miRNA-675及靶癌基因p53的表达水平，并将其表达模式与临床病理学发现相关联。方法：使用RNAfold网络服务器（http://rna.tbi.univie.ac.at/cgi-bin/RNAWebSuite/RNAfold.cgi）预测lncRNA H19的二级结构。从NCBI数据库（https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/）获取H19的FASTA序列。我们利用MDockPP网络服务器（https://zougrouptoolkit.missouri.edu/MDockPP/）进行分子对接研究，以分析miRNA-675与p53之间的相互作用。采用实时PCR检测H19和miR-675的表达量，并使用免疫组织化学分析p53的表达模式。结果：本研究通过计算机模拟分析成功关联了H19第一外显子中的miR-675对p53的调控作用。发现OSCC患者中H19和miR-675水平（3.12 ± 1.16）高于健康患者（1.0 ± 0.0），且差异具有统计学意义（p值 < 0.001）。结论：H19在OSCC中相较于正常组织的特异性表达，为癌症特异性治疗提供了一个有吸引力的靶点，从而降低了脱靶效应的风险。
